subject: UefiCpuPkg: Fix VS2022 NOOPT IA32 build issues
reasons: The commit repeats the same alignment-check rewrite across several C files, replacing bitmask and modulo tests with `IS_ALIGNED()`.
It also applies the same type narrowing pattern to a few SMM bookkeeping variables to avoid 64-bit intrinsic use.
The before/after shape is clear and mostly mechanical, which fits Coccinelle well.
This is a build-fix migration with enough repetition to generalize, even though it is mixed with some local type adjustments.
candidate_pattern: Replace alignment bitmask/modulo checks with `IS_ALIGNED()` and narrow the affected SMM size/index variables to `UINTN` where needed.
